tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background behind every page and the tab bar's surroundings.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, the tab bar, text fields. In dark it sits close to bg, so cards also take a `line` border.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Grouped rows inside a card, the person switcher pill, neutral chips.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of text fields, unselected checkboxes and optional (dashed) chips: 3:1 or more on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on bg, surface and surface-soft (14:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (times, hints, captions) on bg, surface and surface-soft (5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Screen titles and card titles set in Baloo Bhaijaan 2, on bg and surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, the selected tab, progress. Text in `primary` reads on bg and surface (6:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill (10.5:1 light, 6.8:1 dark). Never literal white in dark.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the selected tab and of secondary buttons; `primary` text on it.

tokens.name: orchid
tokens.usage: The accent: the + button, Dr. Usra's heart, female avatars, one highlight per screen. A fill only; text on it is `on-orchid`. Too light for text on bg (2.5:1).

tokens.name: on-orchid
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `orchid` fill (6.4:1).

tokens.name: orchid-soft
tokens.usage: Blush tint behind highlights (next-vaccine countdown, founding-member badge); `ink` or `orchid-ink` text on it.

tokens.name: orchid-ink
tokens.usage: Orchid-family text and icons (female labels, accent links) on bg, surface and orchid-soft.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Male avatars and the second chart series. A fill only; text on it is `on-orchid` (6.8:1).

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind male-profile headers and chart backgrounds.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Sky-family text and icons on bg and surface.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Severity 1, information: icon, title and border of an info notice, on bg, surface and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an info notice.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Severity 2, on track: growth on track, dose taken, vaccine done. Always with a check icon and words.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a good notice and of done chips.

tokens.name: heads-up
tokens.usage: Severity 3, watch: re-measure, due soon. Dark amber so text passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: heads-up-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a heads-up notice.

tokens.name: act-soon
tokens.usage: Severity 4, act soon: overdue vaccine, contact a doctor now.

tokens.name: act-soon-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an act-soon notice.

tokens.name: urgent
tokens.usage: Severity 5, urgent: call 123 now, pregnancy danger signs. Also the fill of the SOS and Call my doctor buttons.

tokens.name: on-urgent
tokens.usage: Text on an `urgent` fill (6.4:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: urgent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an urgent notice.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch-access focus ring: 2px solid, 2px gap. 6:1 or more on bg and surface in both themes.

families.display: "Baloo Bhaijaan 2", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.body: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Greeting at the top of Today, onboarding titles. One per screen.

styles.name: body-lg

styles.name: body

styles.usage: Default text: record details, descriptions, notices.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, buttons' small size, chips, tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sources, timestamps, helper text. Never for doses or warnings.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Times, temperatures, doses and amounts; tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between lines inside a row; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a card; field label to field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the screen's side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Above a screen title; around empty states.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Onboarding and Simple Mode spacing between big buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips inside rows, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and bottom sheets (top corners).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Person switcher, status chips, the + button, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on bg in light mode. Dark mode uses a `line` border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The + button and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: touch-target-simple
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target in Simple Mode; big buttons there are 72px tall.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height, plus the phone's bottom safe area.
